Hello

I am stuck with fitting my model in r.

My model specification is:
specmod<-"

# path c' (direct effect)

 roa ~ c*equity based compensation

# path a
 derivative use ~ a*equity based compensation
 
# path b
 
 roa ~ b*derivative use
 
 # indirect effect (a*b)
 
 ab:=a*b
 "

First and foremost, when I fit the model: fitmod<-sem(specmod, data=df)

It does not appear on the environment suggesting there is an error.

Secondly, the error in the console reads:
Error in if ((!is.matrix(model)) | ncol(model) != 3) stop("model argument must be a 3-column matrix") : argument is of length zero

I will be grateful for your help

thanks alot
